data.title: Bitcoin Slides, Crypto Stocks Decline As Trump-Backed CLARITY Act Fails To Pass Senate Vote
data.description: Bitcoin and crypto-related stocks fell sharply on Tuesday after the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act.
data.keywords: Josh Hawley, Jerry Moran, Patrick Witt, Susan Collins, White House, Republican senators, Donald Trump, Digital Assets, the Senate, Bitcoin, CLARITY Act, Elissa Slotkin
